QuestInfo.name: A Fairy in Need
QuestInfo.0: Ask Kriel the Fairy in Orbis about the fourth Augury.
QuestInfo.1: Kriel the Fairy will give you the Augury...if you do her a favor.
QuestInfo.2: You agreed to help Kriel in exchange for the Augury.

0.0: And what do YOU want? You aren't just another human here to take and take and take and not even say thank you, right? RIGHT?!\r\n#L0##bI've merely come to claim something that is mine by right. Are you familiar with the Aurora Augury?#l\n#k
0.1: That pretty crystal? Yeah, I've been holding onto it. It's yours?\r\n#L0##bIndeed. May I have it?#l\n#k
0.2: Of course! You're welcome to it...

yes.0: ...just as soon as you run some errands for me!

no.0: Not so fast! Hear me out first!
